# Check: upstream select-list.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/select-list.test.ts

## Subject
SelectList component: rendering selectable items with descriptions and alignment.

## Upstream test count (approx)
6

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- normalizes multiline descriptions to single line
- keeps descriptions aligned when primary text is truncated
- uses configured minimum primary column width
- uses configured maximum primary column width
- allows overriding primary truncation while preserving description alignment

## Upstream dependencies
SelectList from ../src/components/select-list.js; visibleWidth; testTheme (selectedPrefix, selectedText, description, scrollInfo, noMatch)

## Upstream notes
SelectList({value, label, description}[], selectedIndex, theme, options). Options: minPrimaryColumnWidth, maxPrimaryColumnWidth, truncatePrimary function. Description alignment computed after primary column width is determined; columns padded to align descriptions.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- grep apps/octo_pi_tui/test for select_list or select tests (no obvious match in current listing)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/select_list.* (implementation location — check for co-located or component/ test dir)

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
